summary: Packaged provenance and installer faults fail closed without VCS, mtime or source-checkout fallbacks.
facts: Missing, malformed, self-digest-tampered, duplicate, incomplete and out-of-order history documents are rejected.
Invalid timezone/type data, NFC path collisions, corpus drift, document hash drift and staged file-content drift are rejected.
The installer rejects a tampered HISTORY.json even after an attacker recomputes the outer staged generation seal.
